'''Plasticast''' was a type of material used in making seats.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a show was organized by the [[Republic Military Benefit Association]] for its troops on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. The bleachers hastily created for the show were made from plasticast.<ref name="MedStar II" />
